title: Bait and switch
body: Great surf data, nice format, but website is free, whereas app requires $$ to see next week. What are they thunking??!!

title: Not refreshing
body: Forecast usually is fine but the app is often not updating and I still need to check the website where I can refresh the page. In the app no option to refresh and even when I logout and quit the app and then login back the data for today is still old. That’s very frustrating taking into consideration that I am paying for premium account

title: Wave height accurate, ratings are not
body: It correctly predicts the height of waves at half a dozen spots in the bay area, but it will randomly suggest a spot is pumping (gold stars) when it’s literally so flat and mushy the wave is not catchable. Probably over indexing on wind and under indexing on tides and stuff. Its also alleging a cross breeze is an offshore on some breaks which are oriented wrong. Also annoying to have to drag a slider to inspect the ratings at different times instead of showing me everything at a glance like the other apps.

title: Mostly good but one big bug
body: Love the app, but on my iPhone, whenever I click the wave icon, it often doesn’t work. Hoping they can fix that because I have to close and reopen the app to get it to work.

title: Not for Great Lakes!!
body: Works great on the oceans, but no tidal info for the Great Lakes. There is plenty of data to link to this app. Perhaps my post will motivate the developers to get to work.

title: Works Fine :)
body: Works good, sometimes wrong for the weather. But great for surfing condition predictions.

title: Accurate and detailed
body: Once you figure out how to read it, this app has a lot of great info and has access to a ton of breaks and I find it to be very accurate. I have the paid version which I find to be worth it.

title: Worth It!
body: I love gauging across multiple platforms and this one continues to be in point. Keep it up.
The best app I’ve ever seen in my life 🫡🫡🫡

title: Cracking Site
body: I’ve got the free version as 200 yards walk I can see my break. But in saying that, it is nice seeing what swells coming through…direction, size, wind etc.

title: Great Report of Surf Conditions
body: Surf-Cast is very helpful in previewing surf conditions in preparation for an outing. Very accurate.

title: Most reliable app
body: While I am not a surfer… I AM an open water swimmer. This app lets me know what I am in store for on any given day. I have looked and compared it to others and I have found it to be the best!

title: Better than Surfline
body: I prefer this app over Surfline because it doesn’t override my audio like Surfline does. As someone with autism, I’m sensitive to apps that take control of sound without warning. This app respects that, which makes a big difference for accessibility. Overall, Surf Forecast does a much better job in terms of usability and accessibility

title: Best forecasts app
body: I love all the features on the app from maps, energy, wind and swell size and direction

title: Great app

title: Surf Casting
body: I can count on surf-forecast to provide current & future conditions to keep me safe while I’m fishing. I have tried other surf apps but I think surf-forecast is far superior to anything else I have tried.

title: Makes my trips better
body: No matter where I go I know about what board to take and what to expect pretty accurate and makes my drive easier to justify the the other half ;)

title: Stay Cool
body: I like this app is way better than Surfline

title: Definitely worth it!
body: Great for surfing, fishing and all other water sports…

title: Best value forecast app
body: The annual subscription for this app is a deal! 12 day forecast for long term planning… and the hourly forecast for making the call between local breaks. Offers more details than Surfline. Most importantly, energy. Not all 3’ days are the same and this criteria (alone with period, direction and wind forecast) seem to be the best currently available.

body: Actual forecast

title: Best for surf fishing
body: Really easy to read tide, sunrise/set, wave power, and wind in one screen. All you need for the basics of scoping out the best beach for surf fishing.

title: Great app - thanks!
body: Thank you for making your data / app available as a mobile app, in addition to the website. You might not be the biggest / most popular surfing forecast app, BUT you are the most comprehensive and whenever i got to less typical / popular location, you got that covered - thank you and appreciate the new mobile app! :)
